paper_title: New ALPS Results on Hidden-Sector Lightweights
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (canonical), as plotted on y-axis
notes: Light-shining-through-wall (LSW) experiment at DESY using HERA dipole (5 T, 8.8 m). Sets 95% CL limits on photon-WISP-photon conversion probability of ~2e-25. Paper constrains multiple WISPs: ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (Fig. 4), hidden-photon kinetic mixing chi (Fig. 5, DarkPhoton), and minicharged particles (Fig. 6). Chosen AxionPhoton per hint and it is the paradigmatic result. Flat ALP bound g_- ~ 7e-8 GeV^-1 derived from measured conversion probability limit; approximate value, valid for m_phi below ~5e-4 eV before coherence gaps appear (Fig.4 shows exclusion in the 1e-4 to 1e-3 eV mass window with gaps filled by gas runs). Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.82, 29)) | Vision: Figure 4 left panel: 95% C.L. exclusion for pseudoscalar ALPs. Traced the lower boundary of the ALPS (red) region, which is the most stringent constraint. X-axis m_phi from 1e-4 to ~2e-3 eV (log), y-axis g_- from 5e-8 to 2e-6 GeV^-1 (log). Boundary is flat (~6.6e-8) at low mass, then rises steeply near ~1 meV where finger/oscillatory structures appear due to coherence loss. Excluded region is above the boundary.
